title: Beruniy Yer radiusini 1 foizdan kam xato bilan topgan

scenes.text: Beruniy Yerni bitta tog' bilan o'lchagan.
Avval tog' balandligini, so'ng cho'qqidan ufq burchagini o'lchadi.
scenes.keywords: man looking at horizon from mountain

scenes.text: Shu burchakdan Yer radiusini topdi, hozirgi qiymatdan bir foizdan kam farq qiladi.
Ming yil oldin, faqat bitta tog' bilan.

description: XI asrda Beruniy hozirgi Pokistondagi Nandana qal'asi yonidagi tog' balandligini va cho'qqidan ufq pasayish burchagini o'lchab, Yer radiusini taxminan 6340 km deb topgan; bugungi o'rtacha qiymat taxminan 6371 km, farq bir foizdan kam.
source: https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Al-Biruni/ (MacTutor: Earth radius from mountain height and horizon dip, Nandana); https://arxiv.org/pdf/1312.7288 (analysis of Biruni's measurement, about 6339.6 km); https://www.iranicaonline.org/?p=9562 (Encyclopaedia Iranica). Result 6339.6 km vs modern mean 6371 km is about 0.5 percent below (0.27 percent vs 6356.7 km polar-based figure); published figures vary slightly with unit conversion.
